Definition: Lowland, i.e. (with the article) the maritime slope of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: 1) lowland, valley; 1a) lowland; 1a1) strip west of Judean mountains (technical term); 1a1a) the Shephelah; 1a2) strip near coast north of Carmel
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
